name: geekflare
title: Geekflare
description: Search the web (including the full Google results page), scrape pages to Markdown, and check websites: uptime, DNS, TLS, redirects, and Lighthouse.
author: chandankumar

commands.name: search-web
commands.title: Search Web
commands.description: Search the live web with Geekflare and open or copy results.

commands.name: check-website
commands.title: Check Website
commands.description: Run a website check: status, DNS, DNSSEC, TLS, redirects, broken links, load time, mixed content, or Lighthouse.

commands.name: scrape-to-clipboard
commands.title: Scrape Page to Clipboard
commands.description: Copy a public page's content as Markdown to the clipboard.

tools.name: search-web
tools.title: Search Web
tools.description: Search the live web, news, or images, or get the full Google results page for a country or city.

tools.name: scrape-page
tools.title: Scrape Page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its content as Markdown.

tools.name: check-website
tools.title: Check Website
tools.description: Run one website check: status, DNS records, DNSSEC, TLS, redirects, broken links, load time, mixed content, or Lighthouse.

preferences.name: apiKey
preferences.title: API Key
preferences.description: Your Geekflare API key from dash.geekflare.com.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
